animation.timing: Existing simulation and clip durations unchanged. Original Reanim transforms interpolated at rendering time.

benchmark.environment: Desktop Codex in-app browser; 45 lobbers + 60 mixed zombies, 30 warm-up + 180 measured frames; texture memory is RGBA estimate, not process RSS; not a mobile-device benchmark.
benchmark.tradeoff: Native part interpolation costs more CPU than baked sprites but reduces texture memory and eliminates stepped character poses.

verification.assetCheck: 4622 frame alpha checks; 108 static images retain alpha, lossless UI retains RGBA, compressed art SSIM >= 0.985
verification.gallery: 160 states across 8 pages inspected; fixed newspaper visibility and splitpea head attachments.
verification.adventureSmoke: 50/50 levels load and render 200 ticks each; not full playthroughs.
verification.pwa: Real waiting worker on isolated localhost: notice shown without settings, dismiss hides, fullscreen keeps notice visible, update click reloads and UI confirms new worker release.
verification.ui: Desktop and 844x390 landscape reviewed. Actual iOS/Android hardware performance remains to verify.

publication: Local commit only; no push or deployment.
